verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The API docs note there is no vendor-hosted or public demo instance and that API keys are live credentials. Tenant isolation and free self-hosting via Docker are adjacent features or user-side workarounds (running a separate instance yourself), not a product-provided sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
